# Accounts

How a neighbor signs up, confirms the account, signs in (email and password, Google or a passkey), connects Google, adds and removes passkeys, and resets or changes a password. It is the site's largest security surface and is not the admin panel. In the CMS: the `users` collection (an agent account is a user too), `passkeys`, `passkey-challenges` and `social-link-requests`, all written by server code only; nothing here is an editor's content. Fields, access and hooks: the [users content type](/docs/reference/content-types/users.md) and its neighbours in the [content types](/docs/reference/content-types/README.md).

## Screens

Six account pages (sign-up, log in, verify, forgot and reset password, `/account`) plus the Google routes under `/auth/`: URLs, data and caching are in the [screens](/docs/reference/routes.md) and [endpoints](/docs/reference/endpoints.md) references. Only `/account` is gated (`requireUser`); every page sets `NOT_INDEXED` and stays out of the sitemap (`src/app/sitemap.ts`).

## How the pieces link

- **Verification** ([note](/src/modules/verification/README.md)): sign-up uses Payload's own verify, not the contact confirmer; verification's retention task keeps an address while an account uses it (`cms/keepAccountEmails.ts`).
- **Agents** ([note](/src/modules/agents/README.md)): an agent account owns an MCP key and can never sign in with a password (`cms/noPasswordSignInForAgents.ts`).
- **Libraries doing the real work:** `openid-client` for Google (only `data/oauthProviders.ts`), `@simplewebauthn/server` for passkeys (only `data/webauthn.ts`), both pinned exactly; Payload's auth for sessions, lockout and password hashing.
- **Flags in request context** that no HTTP caller can set, so a field guard can tell server code from a request: `CURRENT_PASSWORD_CONFIRMED` (`domain/passwordConfirmation.ts`), `NEW_EMAIL_CONFIRMED` (`domain/emailChange.ts`), `SIGN_UP_CONTEXT` (`domain/signUpContext.ts`), `SOCIAL_SIGN_IN_CONTEXT` (`domain/socialSignIn.ts`).
- **Server-only fields** on a user (`serverOnlyFieldAccess`): the resend counters, `verificationSetsPassword`, `verifiedTokenHash`, `googleSub`, `passkeyUserHandle`. `role` reaches the browser only as `CurrentUser.role` and the header's `staff` flag (`data/mappers.ts`).
- Email links are built from the configured site address, never the request's Host (`domain/linkToken.ts`, `domain/paths.ts`).

## Behaviors and events

- **Sign-up** makes a guest who cannot sign in until the emailed link is pressed as Confirm on `/verify-account`, after the robot check, so a mail scanner verifies nothing. The link has no expiry and a resend replaces it (`use-cases/signUpResident.ts`, `use-cases/verifyAccountFromLink.ts`).
- **Quick ways in first** on `/login`: passkey, then Google, then the email form; either button appears only when its switch is on (`ui/SignInMethods.tsx`, `ui/signInButton.ts`). Google needs `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` and `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET`; passkeys need `PASSKEYS_ENABLED=true` (`data/passkeySettings.ts`).
- **Google flow:** `/auth/google` keeps `state`, `nonce` and PKCE in a signed ten-minute cookie; the callback applies `decideSocialSignIn` (`domain/socialSignIn.ts`). Failures go to `/login?social=<code>` with a fixed message (`use-cases/socialSignIn.ts`). Sessions last Payload's two hours.
- **Connecting Google** to a password account (decision 0020): at sign-in the callback parks Google's id and email in `social-link-requests` (purged hourly, `cms/socialLinkRetention.ts`) and `/auth/google/connect` asks for the password once; from `/account` it needs a recent sign-in (`use-cases/connectGoogle.ts`, `domain/googleLink.ts`). A note with the time goes to the account's address. No disconnect yet.
- **Passkeys** (decision 0021): add, list, remove and sign in on `/account` and `/login` (`use-cases/addPasskey.ts`, `use-cases/removePasskey.ts`, `use-cases/signInWithPasskey.ts`). Each change emails the account a note with no link (`domain/passkeyEmail.ts`). An admin's delete in `/admin` sends the removal note too (`cms/passkeyRemovedNote.ts`). A challenge row expires in five minutes; the hourly retention run removes expired ones (`cms/passkeyRetention.ts`).
- **Offer after log in:** `/account` offers a passkey to an account with none; "Not now" is kept a month in the browser only (`ui/PasskeyOffer.client.tsx`, `domain/passkeyOffer.ts`).
- **"Keep me signed in"** stretches session, token and cookie to 7 days for password and passkey sign-in, not Google (`data/rememberedSession.ts`, `domain/sessionLifetimes.ts`).
- **Password change** ends the other sessions; a reset ends all and sets no cookie (`data/session.ts`, `data/passwordReset.ts`).
- **Payload's own verify and forgot routes** answer 403 (`cms/verifyFromSiteOnly.ts`, `cms/forgotPasswordFromSiteOnly.ts`); the GraphQL verify mutation fails a validation rule (`noVerifyMutation` in `src/payload.config.ts`); the admin's verify and forgot pages redirect to the site's (`src/proxy.ts`).
- **A pull request preview** gets four throwaway accounts (admin, editor, resident, guest), made by `src/endpoints/seed/preview-database.ts`, never copied from production ([previews](/ops/previews.md)).

## Shared pieces it uses

- `SlidingWindowCounter`, `HumanVerifier`, `ROLES` from `src/platform/lib`; `TurnstileVerifier` (`src/platform/turnstile`); role checks and `serverOnlyFieldAccess` (`src/platform/payload/roles.ts`); `runAction`, `runUseCase` (`src/platform/service`); `NOT_INDEXED` (`src/platform/seo`); the UI kit's `Form`, `Button` and `Field`.
- Where it meets other modules (decision 0008): pages in `src/app/`, the collection, `noVerifyMutation` and the retention task in `src/payload.config.ts`, redirects in `src/proxy.ts`.

## Rules and the tests that protect them

- **Nobody learns whether an account exists.** Sign-up answers the same for a new and a used email, sign-in has one failure, forgot password answers at once and sends later; every action returns a fixed code, never Payload's text (`data/failures.ts`, `use-cases/requestPasswordReset.ts`, `domain/types.ts`; `actions.signUp.test.ts`, `actions.passwordReset.test.ts`).
- **Public email forms are limited:** per connection, then the robot check, then site-wide (sign-up: 5 an hour per connection and 20 site-wide; forgot password: 5 and 30); counts are in memory, one PM2 process (`use-cases/guardPublicRequest.ts`, `domain/requestLimits.ts`). Provider and passkey sign-in are limited per connection only, since a cap anyone can fill would switch them off for everyone (`use-cases/guardPublicRequest.test.ts`, `use-cases/signInWithPasskey.test.ts`).
- **An unverified account gets no reset email,** and the answer is the same, so nobody can make the site mail someone else's address (`cms/noResetEmailWhileUnverified.ts`; `cms/noResetEmailWhileUnverified.test.ts`).
- **A failed sign-up email deletes the half-made account,** so the address is not stuck as a duplicate; verified or older accounts are never touched (`deleteFailedSignUp` in `data/signUp.ts`; `actions.signUp.test.ts`).
- **A repeat sign-up for an unverified address** resends the link after the answer, one resend at a time per address, within the cap (`use-cases/signUpResident.ts`; `actions.signUp.test.ts`).
- **A resend is capped:** 3 per 3 hours, stored on the account (`domain/verificationResends.ts`; `domain/verificationResends.test.ts`, `actions.signUpResend.test.ts`).
- **Google never takes over an account by email.** A known Google id signs in; a new verified address gets a guest; a used address goes through the password step; locked, unverified and agent accounts are refused (`domain/socialSignIn.test.ts`, `use-cases/socialSignIn.test.ts`, `data/socialAccounts.payload.test.ts`).
- **Linking Google writes once,** only while the account has none, and Google must have verified the email (`domain/googleLink.test.ts`, `use-cases/connectGoogle.test.ts`).
- **Sensitive changes need a recent sign-in** (five minutes from the session's own start, so "keep me signed in" never counts): adding or removing a passkey, connecting Google (`domain/signInSession.ts`; `domain/googleLink.test.ts`, `use-cases/addPasskey.finish.test.ts`).
- **A passkey challenge is used once,** the counter only rises, the handle is a random value never the email, and a wrong or foreign passkey gets the same `failed` (`domain/passkeys.ts`; `domain/passkeys.test.ts`, `data/passkeyChallenges.payload.test.ts`, `use-cases/signInWithPasskey.refused.payload.test.ts`).
- **Passkey sign-in refuses a locked, unverified or agent owner,** by the same rule as provider sign-in (`canSignInTo` in `domain/socialSignIn.ts`, asked in `domain/passkeys.ts`; `domain/passkeys.test.ts`). The relying party is the configured site address, never a request header (`data/passkeySettings.ts`, `data/webauthn.ts`; `data/webauthn.signIn.test.ts`).
- **Passkey limits:** at most 10 per account and a label of up to 60 characters, letters, numbers, spaces and a few marks, so a note email can carry no link; asking to add one is limited per connection and per account, never site-wide (`domain/passkeys.ts`, `domain/requestLimits.ts`; `domain/passkeys.test.ts`, `domain/passkeyLabel.test.ts`).
- **Deleting an account deletes its passkeys** (`cms/deletePasskeysWithAccount.ts`; `cms/deletePasskeysWithAccount.test.ts`). Removing a passkey needs no passkey switch and always comes from the session's own account (`use-cases/removePasskey.ts`; `use-cases/removePasskey.test.ts`).
- **Removing the last passkey is allowed:** every account keeps a password or forgot-password, so nobody is locked out (`use-cases/removePasskey.test.ts`).
- **Sign-up never makes an admin;** only Payload's first registration on an empty database does, and a Google create on an empty database is a guest (`cms/firstAccountIsAdmin.ts`; `cms/signUpFirstAccount.test.ts`, `src/payload.config.roles.test.ts`).
- **Own password and email changes need their flags** (`cms/requireCurrentPassword.test.ts`, `src/payload.config.emailChange.test.ts`); fields no resident can set are in `src/payload.config.protectedFields.test.ts`.
- **No other site frames the sign-in pages:** `/account`, `/login` and `/auth/:provider/connect` send `frame-ancestors 'none'` (`next.config.js`; `src/app/apiHeaders.test.ts`).
- **An MCP key is not a signed-in account:** only a user of the users collection counts (`getSessionPayloadUser` in `data/session.ts`).
- **Roles gate pages:** `requireUser` sends a visitor to sign in, `requireRole` gives a 404 (`use-cases/requireUser.test.ts`); old residents became guests (`src/payload.config.guestMigration.test.ts`).
- **A forged or stale answer from the browser is refused** without saying which check failed (`data/webauthn.ts`, `data/webauthn.signIn.test.ts`, `data/webauthn.registration.test.ts`).

## Boundaries

- Entry files: `index.ts` (types, paths, safe for the proxy), `server.ts` (use cases, forms, `requireUser`), `cms.ts` (collection, never server-only), `actions.ts` (server actions). Layers: `domain/`, `use-cases/`, `data/`, `cms/`, `ui/`; no other module is imported (`eslint.boundaries.config.mjs`).
- The account always comes from the session, never from a form or a caller.

## Decisions

[0003](/docs/architecture/decisions/0003-turnstile-robot-check.md), [0007](/docs/architecture/decisions/0007-email-confirmation.md), [0008](/docs/architecture/decisions/0008-compose-modules-at-the-app-level.md), [0020](/docs/architecture/decisions/0020-social-sign-in.md) (Google), [0021](/docs/architecture/decisions/0021-passkey-sign-in.md) (passkeys).

## Known gaps

- No code sets `NEW_EMAIL_CONFIRMED`: the change-your-email flow (#553) isn't built, so an account's email can't be changed, admins included.
- `requireRole` has no caller outside tests: the owner kept it on purpose (#728, #756), so it is not a defect to file.
- Google cannot be disconnected yet (#1353).
